Official Artist Channel merge

Prepare your YouTube artist identity and understand the official request workflow.

Artist channel details

Eligibility checklist

How the merge works

1

Establish eligibility

Have an artist-owned channel, official music releases on YouTube delivered through a music distributor or label, and comply with current YouTube policies.

2

Request through a supported partner

Use your distributor, label, or another eligible music partner's official OAC request process.

3

Review and wait for YouTube

YouTube and its partners determine approval. The app cannot merge channels directly or guarantee approval.

An Official Artist Channel request is not the same as a YouTube account merge. Keep channel access secure; never share your password or verification codes with a distributor.

Use YouTube's official help and your distributor's current instructions to confirm requirements before applying.
